input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: Argument.get_help_record returns self.help unchanged, so the second element of the tuple is None for an undocumented argument even though format_arguments now feeds every record straight into formatter.write_dl without a fallback.
- failure path: A command declares two arguments and sets help on only one; running it with --help makes write_dl measure and wrap a None description and the help command crashes with a TypeError instead of printing usage.

Reviewer finding
- description: The old code substituted an empty description when an argument had no help text. The new code passes Argument.get_help_record output directly to write_dl, which can contain None as the description.
- rationale: Trigger: a command has one positional argument with help and another without help, so the Positional arguments section is written. Mechanism: the undocumented argument's record is (metavar, None) because Argument.get_help_record returns self.help unchanged, and write_dl receives None as the second column. Impact: help rendering either crashes on None or prints a wrong description, which the removed fallback was there to prevent.
critique: The finding names the same faulty operation: Argument.get_help_record returns self.help unchanged, so it yields a (metavar, None) record. That record is passed to write_dl without the old empty-string fallback, and the trigger is the same: one argument has help and another does not. It also matches the crash-on-None impact.
